align-direct-position.task: User-requested continuous four-leg lift-only video, no additional training

walk.task: Walking (leg_position locomotion) RL policy: gait shaping for normal sequential walk, capsule-length DR 56-60mm, robot-contract-compatible export.

wheel.task: Wheel locomotion: reduce excessive abduction splay in home pose (1.0 -> 0.65 rad) and fine-tune the backpack+9mm wheel policy. W&B project QuadMorph/pupper-wheel.

leg-lift-slow-align.task: Train and validate user-requested wheel-blind leg-lift policy on backpack+9mm wheeled model, position control

codex-leg-length.task: 110 mm heading/obstacle refinement and wheel tracking ablation; 50M each; idle GPUs only
